items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated arbitrary code execution through the webhooks component, requiring no account or login.

items.title: Critical Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw (CVSS 9.8) in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, enabling remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec identified PolyShell (CVSS 9.8), a critical vulnerability in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by bypassing validation with a polyglot.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources and hijack customer accounts.

items.title: Vulnerability to Plant Malicious Files on Server
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows an attacker to plant malicious files on the server, as part of the APSB26-73 security update for Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) addressed in APSB26-73 could lead to privilege escalation or a security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.6) is part of APSB26-73 and could result in privilege escalation or a security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.2) in Adobe Commerce, addressed by APSB26-73, could lead to privilege escalation or a security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.1) is included in APSB26-73 and could result in privilege escalation or a security feature bypass.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Leading to Security Feature Bypass in B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) addressed in APSB26-73 could lead to privilege escalation or a security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Privilege Escalation / Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 7.2) is part of APSB26-73 and could result in privilege escalation or a security feature bypass.
